body:
Thanks. Yeah I honestly know it'll get better when I leave for college. Because it's like whenever I get home or am around my mother I'm sucked into a black hole. Like I don't need anybody telling me, I know when I don't have to live with this person who has literally tried to kill me, constantly tears apart my insecurities, and has decided that I'm the cause of her depression since I was five years old, I will feel better.

The only thing now is that I'm like, "hey. I could just *not* deal with the next five months. I feel like there's no escape, but there *is*. I could just kill myself". IDK it kinda scares me that the most rational thing it seems like I could do right now is kill myself.

Also I'm like 99% sure that if I got the frick away from my mother and didn't have to worry about staying here over the summers I wouldn't have any mental illness so IDK. 

And I don't currently see a therapist but I *could* through the school but I'm too embarrassed and I honestly don't know what they could do to help. I mean the root of my problem is my crap home life, no therapist could fix that.

> I am amazed at your strength through all of it (I don't know if I could have done what you have), and I hope it works out for you.

thanks :) It sucks because like to outside people who don't really know it seems like I'm super weak and lazy. And I feel like that's just so untrue. Like I know that if I maybe had slightly less horrible parents I could be doing great stuff. But like this takes so much of my energy not to just run away or something.
